title: Blue...
description: A small but content-packed mod that adds a brand new biome, unique mobs, custom ore, and fun weapons like Silly Gun and Katana.
body:
This mod adds a new biome to explore, along with several new features, mobs, and items to make your world feel more alive.

**New Biome**

The biome includes a new type of tree with a full wood set. You can use it to craft everything you would expect, such as planks, slabs, stairs, buttons, and signs.

There are also naturally spawning structures:

A house with loot
A fenced area that contains a new mob and additional loot
New Mobs

The biome introduces a creature called the Bluemob. It is normally calm, but if you provoke it, it will attack.

There is also a spider-like monster that spawns at night. It will not attack unless you attack it first.

**New Ore and Equipment**

A new ore can be found in the world. It is useful and strong, and it allows you to craft new gear, including armor, tools, and weapons.

**Special Items**

The mod adds a few unique items:

The Katana, which is a strong and fast weapon
The Silly Gun, a ranged weapon that uses saplings from the new tree as ammo
Crafting Recipes

**Final Notes**

This mod is meant to expand the game with new content while keeping a simple and natural feel that fits well with the base game.

### **_BETA:_**

Sorry guys that it needed some type of stupid mod it was a bug i fixed it and now you can enjoy:

**Added:**

Added a new villager profession that can only be assigned using Magic Ore. Added The Blue, a special food item obtainable only through trading with the new villager profession. The Blue takes 1 minute to consume. After consuming The Blue, it turns into 1 Magic Block. Added The Harden Blue, wich can be crafted from the blue etc... Added The Harden Blue Katana, wich can be crafted from the harden blue etc... Added The Blue Katana, created by processing The Harden Blue Katana in a Blast Furnace. Both katanas are very powerful, with The Blue Katana being the stronger version.

**Trading:**

The Blue can be traded for 6 Emeralds and 5 Magic items from the new villager.
